Name: Pam Edit
Author: pipmimi
Description:
(Updated for version 1.6)
The default Pam sprite has her nose above her eyes.
I've given her a little nose job.
Now includes Pam's beach and winter sprites

To install:
Unzip the folder,
Then simply drag and drop into: Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Content/Characters
(Don't forget to make a back-up just incase you change your mind!)

If you like this edit check out my ones for Marnie and Gus - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2455]Marnie Edit[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3050/]Gus Edit[/url]
